name: slack_find_channel
description: Resolve a Slack channel name (like #team-ai-lab) to a channel ID by paginating accessible channels.

parameters.name: --channel_name
parameters.description: Slack channel name to resolve, with or without leading #.

parameters.name: --channel_id
parameters.description: Exact Slack channel ID to look up.

usage_guidance: Provide at least one of channel_name or channel_id. Paginates all accessible channels to find a match.
returns: JSON with ok, found (bool), channel object (if found), and total_channels_scanned.
